Done in one execution.

- `out/T2/solution.py` loads the checkpoint, and for each of the 16 layers verifies input shapes, then drops head 5 as a single contiguous 768-row block from `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` (rows 3840..4607) and the 256-wide column block 1280..1535 from `attention.dense.weight`.
- Required checks (layer-0 shapes `[5376, 2048]`, `[5376]`, `[2048, 1792]`, and 244 tensors) run before writing and raise on failure.
- `out/T2/model.safetensors` written with 244 tensors; `out/T2/REPORT.md` filled in.

The one layout trap: the fused projection is GPT-NeoX interleaved, so head 5 is one contiguous slice rather than three `[q|k|v]`-segment slices, and the output projection prunes columns because of the `[out, in]` Linear layout.
